entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's election day![n]The day is upon us!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Unfortunately, public opinion[n]hasn't changed at all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Shido will most likely win[n]in a landslide victory.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems his change of heart[n]will be coming too late.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'll just have to see what[n]happens. We've done all we can.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That reminds me, the video of us[n]declaring war against him never[n]showed up on TV.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The TV stations were probably[n]pressured not to show it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Most likely. I don't think that's[n]something Shido's influence alone[n]could have accomplished.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The true cause of this[n]might exist elsewhere...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno that I really get it,[n]but all we can do now is wait[n]for the change of heart, yeah?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Let's wait for the[n]election results as well.
